from pathlib import Path

ratio = 10 / 2
steps = 10 // 2
message = f"rate {10 / 2}"
compact = 10 /2
parenthesized = 10 /(1 + 1)
compact_message = f"rate {10 /2}"
relative = Path("outputs") / "result.json"
separator = "/"
assert ratio == 5 and steps == 5 and message == "rate 5.0"
assert relative.as_posix() == "outputs/result.json" and separator == "/"
print("source consumed")
